title: Intent to publish unverified information
description: Fahad suggests mentioning political figures by name and claiming they are aware of certain matters, even if there is no proof to support such claims, which is a form of misleading the public.
snippet:
فهد:
نذكر الأسماء.
نقول إنهم يعرفون.
حتى لو ما عندنا إثبات.
حسام يغلق شاشة الحاسوب.

title: Misleading by implication
description: Fahad expresses his intent to make people suspicious by merely listing names of countries and entities, even without direct accusations, which is a form of misleading by implication.
snippet:
لا يوجد اتهام مباشر.

title: Spreading fabricated stories and rumors without evidence
description: Fahd explicitly states his plan to use fake accounts to spread rumors and fabricate stories about corruption, cover-ups, and secret orders, even without any supporting evidence, aiming to incite public distrust.
snippet:
فهد: نعم. نستخدم حسابات وهمية، نكتب إشاعات… ونركّب قصص عن “فساد” و“تستر” و“أوامر سرية”… حتى لو ما عندنا دليل.
حسام: هذا كذب.
فهد (يضرب الطاولة): الكذب يمشي. الناس تصدق اللي يخوفها. وإذا ما صدقوا… نخوفهم أكثر.

title: Justifying media deception through fear
description: Fahd asserts that lies are effective because people believe what scares them, and if they don't believe, they will be scared more, explicitly outlining a strategy of using fear and deception to manipulate public opinion.
snippet:

title: Creating deceptive audio content with altered voice
description: Fahd records an audio clip, deliberately altering his voice with a filter, to spread misleading information and incite public unrest, indicating an intent to deceive the audience about the source.
snippet:
فهد يسجل مقطعًا صوتيًا، ويغير صوته بفلتر.
فهد (صوت مزيف): “مصدر خاص أكد أن هناك أوامر سرية… وأن الناس لازم تنتفض…” “الوضع في البلد والاقتصاد في النازل…” “ولا تصدقون الإعلام… كله كذب في كذب…”
يرسل المقطع. يضحك.

title: Spreading false claims and discrediting media
description: Fahd, using a fake voice, spreads unverified claims about secret orders and economic decline, and explicitly tells people not to trust media, calling it 'all lies,' which is a direct act of media deception and discrediting legitimate media.
snippet:

title: Inciting unrest and planning denial of responsibility
description: Fahd expresses his intent to incite public unrest and then deny responsibility by claiming 'we didn't mean it,' demonstrating a deceptive strategy to manipulate public perception and evade accountability.

title: Accusation of incitement and misinformation by authorities

title: عرض ملف مسرّب على شاشة الحاسوب

title: ذكرى عاشوراء ومناسبة دينية
description: دخول امرأة مسنّة تحمل كتابًا صغيرًا وتذكر أن المجلس يقام سنويًا في ذكرى عاشوراء، واصفة إياها بمناسبة دينية مهمة.

مها:

حسام:

title: رواية عن واقعة تاريخية مختلف عليها

المرأة:

المرأة:
